posts.title: DIY
posts.description: Do It Yourself Its a mindset. Its a life style. Its necessity. Its a response to your surroundings. It reflects the surroundings around you. We might not be in the most ideal place but its our place. The things we create show how bad of a place it is But also how good of a place it is. And as we create... We are making it better
